[[Overseer/Legends|Overseer]] '''Brynn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] within the ranks of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Brynn was assigned to command an Imperial [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] control center in the settlement [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she encountered a band of fugitives who were on the run from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] and had infiltrated the control center in an attempt to release the [[Docking clamp/Legends|docking clamps]] on the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Krayt Fang]]''. The fugitives escaped Tatooine,<ref name="Beginner Game" /> but returned a short [[Time/Legends|time]] later to confront Teemo, and they encountered Overseer Brynn once again.<ref name="TLAotH">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>
